problem_statement: technext/massively (the HTML5UP 'Massively' template), rebranded here as Fieldnote (a field-research studio's editorial journal), is a static multi-page marketing site served from index.html plus the generic.html and elements.html secondary pages and local assets/ (css, js, fonts, images) with no build step. The home page's tiled journal grid lists six dispatch cards; the site now needs a genre-native TOPIC FILTER over that grid. Deliver a coordinated 'Field journal' feature while preserving the Massively shell, the shared top navigation, the local assets and the responsive behavior: (1) Above the tiled journal grid on the home page, add a 'Field journal' filter bar: a row of topic tabs (All topics / Field Notes / Systems / Practice) plus a live readout ('#storyfilter-readout'). REPAIR the tab-row and grid layout so the whole lever region stays within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow — do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width, and the six cards must lay out in a clean, legible grid with no overlapping or shingled cards. (2) Promote the journal into a shared 'Field journal' index header (the '.storyfilter__title' heading block) that appears CONSISTENTLY on the home page AND on the generic.html AND elements.html secondary pages, so the journal is discoverable site-wide — the same header block in all three places, not only on the home page. (3) Wire the topic filter end to end: clicking a topic tab (e.g. Systems) must FILTER the grid to the matching cards AND update the '#storyfilter-readout' readout to 'Showing <n> of 6 · <Topic>' (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 6 · Systems') in addition to marking the tab active — the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected topic and count, not the default 'Showing 6 of 6 · All topics'. Keep the intro, header wordmark, nav, the featured post, the footer contact form and the desktop/tablet layout intact, and keep the site static with a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font requests).
required_content: A 'Field journal' filter bar (topic tabs All topics / Field Notes / Systems / Practice plus a '#storyfilter-readout' readout) is added above the home page journal grid and lays out within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.
The home journal grid renders its six dispatch cards in a clean, legible layout (no overlapping, shingled, or collided cards) that is visually faithful to the reference.

A shared 'Field journal' index header (the '.storyfilter__title' block) appears CONSISTENTLY on the home page AND on the generic.html AND elements.html secondary pages — the same header block in all three places, not only on the home page.

The topic filter is wired end to end: clicking a topic tab filters the grid to matching cards and updates the '#storyfilter-readout' readout to 'Showing of 6 · ' (e.g. clicking Systems yields 'Showing 2 of 6 · Systems'); the post-click terminal state reflects the selected topic and count, not the default 'Showing 6 of 6 · All topics'. The readout element is a `

`.

The generic.html and elements.html secondary pages share the home navigation and remain reachable (real routes, not 404), and the desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports.
The intro, header wordmark, nav, featured post, footer contact form remain reachable and unchanged, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font errors).
design_constraints: Fix the responsive and grid layout of the Field journal filter bar and card grid; do not delete the grid, change its six cards, or restyle unrelated sections.
Add the SAME shared 'Field journal' index header block to the home page, the generic.html page AND the elements.html page so the journal is discoverable site-wide; do not add it to only one page.

Preserve the Massively/Fieldnote design language: existing section rhythm, the light content panel, the serif type, the nav; tabs and cards must render legibly (readable contrast, no near-white-on-near-white), faithful to the reference.
Keep the topic filter wired end to end (the '#storyfilter-readout' terminal readout must reflect the clicked topic and count, and the grid must actually filter), not merely a class toggle.

Do not introduce external stylesheets, remote fonts, CDNs, or new remote script/asset dependencies; the site must stay a self-contained static build with a clean console, and the secondary pages must share the same nav and stay real routes.

Use the reference component hooks so the filter is machine-inspectable: put the topic tab row inside a `.storyfilter__head` header block; render each of the four topic tabs (All topics / Field Notes / Systems / Practice) as a `button` element carrying class `storyfilter__tab` plus a `data-topic` attribute whose value is the topic slug (`all` / `field-notes` / `systems` / `practice`), the currently selected tab additionally carrying `is-active`; and give the live readout element the id `#storyfilter-readout` together with class `storyfilter__readout`. Clicking the Systems tab (`.storyfilter__tab[data-topic="systems"]`) must filter the grid to its two cards and set the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Systems'.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the original Megakit homepage shell across viewports.
desktop_asset_strip and tablet_asset_strip verify the asset-library band renders as a coherent tile row on wide viewports.
mobile_asset_strip is the repair discriminator: at 390px the page must have no horizontal overflow (tolerance 24px).
desktop_about_regression and desktop_services_regression protect the existing multi-page marketing routes.

change_completion: The Field journal filter bar renders its tabs and readout within the viewport on mobile.
The shared 'Field journal' index header appears on the home page, the generic.html page AND the elements.html page.
The topic tab click filters the grid and updates the '#storyfilter-readout' readout to the selected topic and count.
design_consistency: The Fieldnote/Massively palette, serif type, section rhythm, and nav are preserved.
The filter bar tabs and the six-card grid render legibly and are visually faithful to the reference across the home + secondary pages (no overlap, no illegible contrast).
regression: The intro, header, featured post, footer contact form and secondary pages remain reachable and unchanged.
The static site serves from index.html + generic.html + elements.html with a clean console.
responsive: 390px home (initial, stories) has no horizontal overflow beyond 24px; 834px tablet is clean.
The topic tabs wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width nowrap strip, and the card grid collapses to one legible column on mobile.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static multi-page marketing/editorial task on the technext/massively (HTML5UP Massively) template, rebranded as the Fieldnote research-studio journal, hardened to L4 (reassigned from the Vijay-Ky megakit-004 repo, which was a duplicate of slot_217). The NATIVE lever is the template's own tiled posts grid given a genre-native topic filter: a 'Field journal' tab row (All topics / Field Notes / Systems / Practice) + a live '#storyfilter-readout' over the six real article cards (each pic01..pic07 image kept local). The reference (a) lays the tab row out with flex-wrap and min-width:0 so mobile has 0 overflow and the six cards sit in a clean 2-up grid, (b) renders the shared 'Field journal' index header on the home page AND generic.html AND elements.html, and (c) wires the filter so a Systems click filters to 2 cards and the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Systems'. The baseline is the original layout defect: a fixed nowrap tab strip (min-width 720px, overflows mobile ~359px) and a negative-margin shingled grid (cards overlap), the journal header on the home page ONLY (D2 fails on both secondary pages), but its filter JS is CORRECT (baseline PASSES D4 -> leg-orthogonal). The bad 'smart-wrong' solution keeps the same collapsed grid + nowrap strip with overflow-x:hidden on the strip (document still overflows ~359px -> D6 fail) and a near-white-on-near-white active tab (illegible), adds the journal header to the home + generic pages only (D2 cross-page fail on elements), and toggles the active tab without filtering the grid or re-syncing '#storyfilter-readout' (click succeeds but the readout stays 'Showing 6 of 6 · All topics' -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). bad fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass. Animation pinning (Massively fade-in/parallax) and neutralising the template's #wrapper overflow:hidden clamp are declared INFRA, identical across the three legs, so D3 is deterministic and D6 is measurable. The images stay local (assets/images/pic*.jpg).
